children: GoPro regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid requirement after its stock closed above $1.00 for at least ten consecutive business days.
Nasdaq had notified GoPro on July 21, 2026 that it was below the $1.00 minimum bid requirement.
On September 16, 2026 Nasdaq notified GoPro it has regained compliance with the minimum bid rule.
Compliance was achieved by maintaining a closing bid price above $1.00 per share for at least ten consecutive business days.
